title: goose adapter
description: Managed block in the global goose AGENTS.md (core rules inline, router just in time) and five agents in ~/.agents/agents. Skills come from ~/.agents/skills.
postInstall: goose: the core rules are a managed block in AGENTS.md in the goose config folder (~/.config/goose; on Windows assumed to be %APPDATA%/Block/goose/config, check it). goose loads it only while CONTEXT_FILE_NAMES is unset or includes AGENTS.md. The rules are inlined because @ includes of home-relative paths are not documented. Agents in ~/.agents/agents have only name and description; goose has no read-only setting, so the read-only roles state it in their instructions. No hooks are installed; see components/goose/HOOKS.md.
